title: ITS2 Metabarcoding Protocol
author: Tomasz Suchan
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.vdye27w

steps.title: Prepare First PCR Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a reaction mix containing molecular grade water, Q5 polymerase buffer, ITS2-S2F primer, ITS2-4R primer (0.16 µL), dNTPs (25 mM each), and Q5 Hot Start polymerase.

steps.title: Add Template to First PCR Mix
steps.instruction: Add 1 μl of the template to 7 μl of the prepared mix.

steps.title: Run First PCR Program
steps.instruction: Execute the PCR thermal cycling program.

substeps.instruction: 12 cycles of: denaturation at 98°C for 10 s and combined annealing/extension at 72°C for 30 s (shuttle PCR)

steps.title: Verify PCR Profiles
steps.instruction: Check the PCR profiles on a gel.

steps.title: Purify First PCR Products
steps.instruction: Perform AMPure purification using a 1x ratio and elute in 10 μl, following the protocol by Tomasz Suchan.

steps.title: Prepare Second PCR Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a reaction mix containing molecular grade water, Q5 reaction buffer, dNTPs (25 mM each), and Q5 Hot Start polymerase.

steps.title: Add Indexed Primers to Second Mix
steps.instruction: Add 1 μl of each 5 uM primer (forward and reverse) to the mix, using a different pair of indexed primers for each sample.

steps.title: Add Sample to Second PCR Mix
steps.instruction: Add 2 μl of the sample to 18 μl of the mix.

substeps.instruction: Use water instead of sample for blanks
Include one 'PCR blank' at this step
Include the 'extraction blank' from the DNA extraction step

steps.title: Run Second PCR Program
steps.instruction: Execute the second PCR thermal cycling program.

substeps.instruction: 20 cycles of: denaturation at 98°C for 40 s, annealing at 49°C for 40 s, and elongation at 72°C for 40 s

steps.title: Purify Second PCR Products
steps.instruction: Perform AMPure purification using a 1x ratio and elute in 100 μl, following the protocol by Tomasz Suchan.

steps.title: Normalize and Pool Samples
steps.instruction: Pool samples together, normalizing concentrations based on experimental requirements.

substeps.instruction: Option 1: Purify samples separately using AMPure, quantify, and pool in equimolar proportions

steps.title: Final Quality Control and Sequencing
steps.instruction: Verify sample quality and prepare for sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Add 15% PhiX to the sequencing run
